title: Split hero with proof strip
description: Two-column opening section: product statement and primary action on one side, a real product view on the other, followed by a strip of verifiable proof points.
intent: Open a product page with what it does and evidence it works, not decoration.
characteristics: proof points backed by data sources
interaction: Primary and secondary actions only; no autoplaying media.
responsive: Stacks to one column below 768px with the statement first.
accessibility: Single h1; screenshot has descriptive alt text; proof strip is a list.
limitations: Needs a real product view; weak when the product has no visual surface.
